# Little Upgrades

> Little Upgrades is a UK-based curated storefront sourcing useful products for everyday life across kitchen, toys, pets, skincare, travel, workspace, and home.

Website: https://littleupgrades.co.uk
Contact: info@littleupgrades.co.uk
Locale: en-GB

## Pages

- [Home](https://littleupgrades.co.uk/): Brand overview and category scope
- [Shop](https://littleupgrades.co.uk/shop): Collection direction and product categories
- [About](https://littleupgrades.co.uk/about): Brand positioning and sourcing approach
- [Contact](https://littleupgrades.co.uk/contact): Enquiry form for customers and partners
